correctness.rationale: The exact off-diagonal block formula and nonnegative row and column sums yield the upper Schur estimate. Near-maximal arbitrarily long windows give a matching lower estimate by flat test vectors. Fekete subadditivity then proves the norm-growth limit; inverse follows by substitution and homogeneous equality by long flat vectors. Entire infinite claim proved analytically; finite tests are supplementary.
